richiami.difetto: On affected machines the high voltage fuse on the MY24 LiveWire S2 Del Mar electric motorcycle may open under certain riding conditions resulting in a loss of propulsion.
richiami.modello: S2 Del Mar , S2 Del Mar
richiami.rimedio: Installation of a higher voltage fuse.
